weeklyPlayerContext.method: Last completed team game at the player's cutoff versus his previous three recorded appearances on the same team. Injuries/depth are separately dated current context; no return dates or causal effect are inferred.

snapshotInfo.source: 2026 Week 3 radar candidate CSV; scoring and usage verified against cutoff-limited nflverse player-week and ffopportunity data.
snapshotInfo.provenance: Historical view generated later from data through Week 3; not a verified pre-Week 4 saved prediction or original screenshot.
snapshotInfo.limitations: Only the original radar-eligible pool is included, not all NFL players. Historical market prices, injury reports and prospective forecasts are unavailable. Weekly detail is linked for 10 players; missing detail is not zero.
